rippleNotAccurateTip: At {layers} air-gap layer(s)/side the rotor- and stator-side rings disagree by {err} % of the ripple scale: the mesh, not the machine, sets the ripple. Torque, losses and heat are fine. Refine ripple solves this point at 3 layers/side or more, for the ripple only; the mesh settings and the duty stay as they are.
